style.styleTitle: Dibor Berries and Baubles 150cm PreLit Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: A traditional Christmas decoration to brighten up your home, our light up garland is densely packed with festive decorations. Sprigs of evergreen fir are interwoven with an array of other botanical leaves as well as giant pinecones for a woodland foraged effect, all artfully arranged into a generous length that will make the perfect feature to display on your mantelpiece and beautifully frame your fireplace. The forest green colours are complemented by bushels of shining red berries and plump rose hips, whilst frosted and glossy red baubles are studded throughout the luxurious garland for a wonderfully classic finishing touch. A delicate string of LED fairy lights is woven throughout the garland to fill your room with a warm golden glow that s sure to make those cold winter evenings feel cosy. Just the thing for creating a welcoming atmosphere for your family and guests. The handy loop at the end allows you to easily hang it in place on a hook. An everlasting alternative to fresh arrangements that you can display year upon year. Requires 3x AA batteries (not included). L150cm Size: ONE.
